spans.s:
--चण्डालस्; with minds controlled and resign- ed to Hari are better than Brahmans not devoted to God; were honoured by कृष्ण; become pure by bhakti (also श्वाद s.v.);
1: भा. I. ११. २२;

. १०; XI. १४. २१.
meat eaters with whom Satyavrata-त्रिशन्कु lived.
2: Br. III. ६३. ८१; वा. ८८. ८२.

--a son of वृष्णि; elder brother of Citraka; married गान्दिनी, daughter of a काशी king. अक्रूर was the foremost of his twelve sons. काशी, not visited by rains for long had a heavy shower just at his marriage, and during his stay at the invitation of the काशी king, whose daughter he married. A righteous king in whose kingdom there was neither famine nor disease. भा.

--a son of पृश्नि--a righteous and great king; no disease or famine during his reign; when the काशि kingdom suffered from want of rain continuously for three years Svaphalka was invited to live there and there were rains; he then married काशिराज's daughter गान्दिनी who gave in gift, every day one cow for a Brahman;
1: वा. ९६. १०१-105.
his daughter नरा, was the wife of भन्गकार.
2: Ib. ९६. ८६.
--a hell; the abode of Vratins and Brahma- चारिन्स् with an uncontrolled body, taught and disciplined by sons, and ब्रह्मचारिस् that sleep during day time. Br.
--the country of, watered by नलिनी. Br. II. १८. ६०.
(I)--a daughter of उत्तानपाद. Br. II. ३६. ९०; वा. ६२. ७७.
(II)--a daughter of Kardama and one of the wives of Atharva Angiras; son Gautama. Br.
--unfit to be seen during a श्राद्ध; touching it is a sin. Br. III. १४. ४८; ७८, ८८; २७. १५; Vi. III. १६. १२.
--the third loka; Sva was uttered and divaloka came of; where Gandharvas, Apsaras, यक्षस्, Guhyakas, and नागस् live; intervening between सूर्य and Dhruva. Br. II. १९. १५५; २१. २१;
--a sage of the epoch of Bhautya Manu. Br.
--a Rudra on the षोडश cakra. Br. IV. ३४. २६.
--oblation to dogs; स्याम and शबल. वा. १११. ३९.
--the Asura whose city is in Tatvalam. Br. II. २०. १८.
--in the first tala of the Atalam. वा. ५०. १७.
--a son of वृजिनिवत, and father of रुशकु. भा. IX. २३. ३१. [page३-494+ ३०]
--a son of वृजिनीवान् and father of रुशेकु; the best of the performers of fire oblations. Br. III. ७०. १६; वा. ९५. १५.
--a son of वृकदेवी and Vasudeva. वा. ९६. १८०.
--to be fed on festival days. भा. X. २४. २८.
--a lake in the चन्द्रप्रभा hill near कैलास. Br. II. १८. 6.
--a R. in the चन्द्रप्रभा hill. Br. II. १८. 6.

(I)--a daughter of दक्ष and consort of अग्नीस्: (पितृस्-वा। प्।, and वि। प्।) gave birth to two daughters [page३-725+ २५] वयुना (मेना-वा। प्।) and धारिणी, who were Brahma- वदीन्स्. भा.
(II)--a wife of Angiras--mother of पितृस्. भा.
(III)--married Kavi Agni: her sons were काव्यस्: her daughter the source of पितृस् with forms. ^1 Br.
(IV)--a god of one of the ten branches of the Harita गण. Br.

(VI)--the essence milked by Antaka for पितृस्;
1: M. १०. १९.
out of this came पितृस्
1: M. १०. १९.
(Somapas).

--the exclamation or benediction used in presenting oblation to departed ancestors. वा. ७३. ५२.
--a manifestation of Hari in the epoch of Manu रुद्रसावर्णि: born of Satyasaha and सूनृता. भा. VIII. १३. २९. [page३-726+ ३१]
--the nectar of the moon in the कृष्ण- पक्ष is स्वाध drunk by पितृस् and low class of deities and in the शुक्लपक्ष it is अमृत drunk by Gods. वा. ५२. ३८, ४०; ६२. १८५.

--dreams, bad and good; ceremonies must be performed for bad ones; after a bad dream, one must try to sleep for sometime; after a good dream one must try to be awake lest it should be followed by a bad one for the latter will generally come true. Dream had in the first of the four divisions of the night will come true in a year; that had in the second will come true in six months; that had in the third, will come true in three months and that had early in the morning will come true in १० days. M. २४
--an Asura in the सभा of हिरण्यकशिपु. M. १६१. ८०. [page३-727+ २७]
--a son of भृगु and a Deva. Br.

(I)--the one god in three forms: creating, protecting and destroying: only sectarians speak of each of these as separate: the one of the three गुणस्;
1: Br.

2: वा. 4. ४४.

(II)--a son of प्रतिक्षत्र (प्रतिक्षिप्त- वा. P.) and father of हृदीक. Br. III. ७१. १३९; वा. ९६. १३८; Vi. IV. १४. २३.
--the गान्धर्व form of marriage. Br. IV. १५. 4.
--नारद set his mind on विष्णु as revealed in Svara. भा.
--a son of गायत्री and प्रजापति. वा. २१. ४२.
--seven svaras, three ग्रामास्, २१ mu1r- chanas and ४९ ta1nas (तालस्-वा। प्।). Br. III. ६१. २९; वा. ८६. ३६, ४९.
(I)--he, who conquers this world and the anta- रिक्ष. Br. II. १६. १७. M. ११४. १६.
(II)--one of the seven rays of the sun helping the planet शनैश्चर. Br. II. २४. ६७; वा. ५३. ४९.
--son of तुषित in the Uttama manvantara. वा. ६७. ३५.

--(see Manu) second Manu; four sons, seven sages of whom Datta was the first; the Devas of the epoch were तुषितस्; then lived the seven sons of the sage वसिष्ठ, all प्रजापतिस्; आकाररूप।
2: वा. २६. ३३; ६२. 3, 7, १८-19.
^1 भा.
(I)--a son of जामि and Dharma, father of Nandi. भा.
(II)--a son of भीम and Diks. Br. II. १०. ८२; २७. ५४.
--a son and commander of भण्ड. Br. IV. २१. ८३; २६. ४९.
--a son and commander of भण्ड. Br. IV. २१. ८३; २६. ४९. [page३-730+ २७]
--a तीर्थ wherefrom the Sapta- ऋषिस् reached heaven; noted for Nandi's shrine. Br. III. १३. ६१.

--is Svarlokam as also divam; the space between the sun and Dhruva; residents of, feed on soma and आज्य; attacked by Malaka and other Asuras; Devas defeated them after refreshing themselves with nectar got by churn- ing of the ocean on the advice of विष्णु; see Svarga. Br.
--a R. fit for श्राद्ध offering. Br. III. १३. १०३.
--a son and commander of भण्ड. Br. IV. २१. ८३; २६. ४९.
--seen by Angiras on the hills of the अमरकण्टक. वा. ७७. 9.
--a R. in the विष्णुस्थानम्. Br. III. ३७. 9.
--a god of one of the ten branches of the Rohita गण. Br.
--an उपद्वीप attached to जम्बूद्वीप. भा. V. १९. ३०.
--a son of Danus, and father of a daughter, प्रभा.
--a son of Mahasoman (महारोम्ण- वा। प्।) and father of Hrasvaroman. भा. IX. १३. १७; Br. III. ६४. १४; वा. ८९. १४. Vi.
--a daughter of Samudra and wife of प्राचीन- barhis. वा. ६३. २५.

--a नाग in the fifth talam or महातलम्. Br. II. २०. ३७; वा. ५०. ३६.

--a class of sages of Atreya fold; ten sons of Atri by his ten apsara wives; famous for their learning in the Vedas and knowledge of Brahman. Br.
--a son of दक्षिण and a तुषित god. भा.
--a son of शकुनि and father of Suvarcas. Br. III. ६४. २१; वा. ८९. २०.

(III)--a son of ध्वजिनीवन् and father of रुशन्कु. Vi. IV. १२. 2.
